title: mushroom rice soufflé
ingredients: 4-5 oz Parmesan; grated via hand grater or powdered in a blender
2 green onion or chives; thinly sliced
3 Cups dry (rice cooker Cup) white rice
2 tsp kosher salt, plus more for mushrooms and onions
instructions: Add olive oil to a pan and cook onion and mushroom with a small pinch of salt until moisture is released. Don't need to fully brown
Meanwhile, break eggs into a large mixing bowl and lightly whisk to combine.
Add cheese, rice, mushrooms, onion and  green onion and season with 2 tsp kosher salt and pepper if using.
Can cook a tiny bit in a pan to test seasoning if desired.
Grease and split into one large or two smaller glass baking trays.
Cook for 18-20 minutes until the top is almost firm, then broil for 2 minutes to brown and crisp the top.
Let cool as long as possible, then cut and stack.
notes: Rice can be cooked and stored in the fridge up to 3 days in advance. 3 rice cooker Cups is 2 US Cups.
